notLevied.why: 4100: national immovable property tax abolished: Immovable Property Tax Law 24/1980 s. 27 (inserted by 86(I)/2016): the obligation to levy the tax 'από την 1η Ιανουαρίου 2017 ... καταργείται' (cylaw consolidated text, Wayback 2025-10-09, law/cylaw_1980_1_24_ipt_cap20251009.html); municipal and community immovable property fees not read (registry map for those); grade B

4300: no inheritance or gift tax: the Estate Duty Law 67/1962 (which also reached gifts deemed to pass on death) is repealed for persons who died on or after 1 January 2000 by Law 74(I)/2000 art. 2 ('Ο βασικός νόμος καταργείται σε σχέση με πρόσωπα που απεβίωσαν κατά ή μετά την 1η Ιανουαρίου 2000'; OG 3413 of 16/06/2000; cylaw Wayback 2022-02-20 of nomoi/arith/2000_1_074.pdf, law/cylaw_2000_1_074.pdf); the estate of a person dying after that date owes only the taxes listed by Law 78(I)/2000 (income tax, SDC, immovable property tax, capital gains); no separate gift tax law found; grade A

4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the Republic of Cyprus (1960) art. 24(2): no contribution by way of tax, duty or rate of any kind whatsoever shall be imposed save by or under the authority of a law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Cyprus_2013.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: ITL 118(I)/2002, SDC Law 117(I)/2002, CGT Law 52/1980, Stamp Duty Law 19/1963, VAT Law 95(I)/2000, Excise Duties Law 91(I)/2004, Law 74(I)/2000 (estate duty repealed). convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).

6000: no zakat or other tax outside the taxes listed: Constitution of the Republic of Cyprus (1960) art. 24(2): no contribution by way of tax, duty or rate of any kind whatsoever shall be imposed save by or under the authority of a law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Cyprus_2013.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: ITL 118(I)/2002, SDC Law 117(I)/2002, CGT Law 52/1980, Stamp Duty Law 19/1963, VAT Law 95(I)/2000, Excise Duties Law 91(I)/2004, Law 74(I)/2000 (estate duty repealed). convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
